description: Set or clear a device-native scrolling text overlay. Use mode "set" to add or update an overlay on a slot (0–19); use mode "clear" to remove it. Overlays use device-rendered fonts (115 font IDs, 0–114) and persist across channel switches until explicitly cleared with mode "clear". Not previewable — rendering happens on-device. Best for persistent tickers over pushed scenes; for styled, previewable text use pixoo_display_text instead.

color.description: Text color: hex (#RRGGBB or #RGB) or a named color such as orange (default: white).

font.description: Device font ID (0–114). 0 = default, 18 = arrows, 20 = °C/°F. Device-rendered; no preview.

id.description: Overlay slot ID (0–19). Each ID is an independent overlay layer.

mode.description: set = add/update overlay; clear = remove it.

width.description: Text region width in pixels, 0 to display size (64 on a 64px display; defaults to display width).

x.description: X start position, 0 to display size − 1 (63 on a 64px display; default: 0).

y.description: Y start position, 0 to display size − 1 (63 on a 64px display; default: 0).

name: pixoo_overlay_text

acknowledged.description: True when the device confirmed the overlay command (error_code: 0).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `device_unreachable`: Device is not reachable. `device_http_error`: The device answered with a non-2xx HTTP status (retryable for 408, 429, 500, and 502–504). `device_rejected`: Device firmware rejected the command. `no_device_configured`: PIXOO_IP is not set. `invalid_color`: The color value could not be resolved. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

id.description: The overlay slot ID (0–19) that was operated on.

title: pixoo_overlay_text
